evaluation_note: Keep prompt text, questions, model weights, backend, and score extraction identical. Compare same-image visible-smile and person-present probabilities at each budget; log per-image score delta and any label-threshold flips alongside end-to-end latency. Four images are a smoke set, not a quality benchmark. The two Library of Congress smile images are labeled no-known-restrictions rather than CC0.
